baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence غَدَوْا ... عَلَىٰ حَرْدٍ ... قَادِرِينَ joins early movement, a directed stance, and effective capacity.
baseline_models.mechanism: A synchronized departure at the opening of day is carried by settled aim and culminates in the actors' sense that their intention can be converted into control.

activation_trace.role: Early-day setting out supplies the timed launch of the action.
Intending and aiming supplies the fixed orientation on which the departure proceeds.
Capacity reaching effective control makes the aim feel executable rather than merely wished.

changed_reading.before: They went out early while able.
changed_reading.after: They move as a coordinated operation: timed departure becomes fixed aim and then a claim of effective control.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The prepositional stance عَلَىٰ حَرْدٍ can carry withholding, while قَادِرِينَ can carry both power and constriction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Withholding is not merely the intended object; it is the footing of their action. Their capacity consists in making another's share narrow, so power and scarcity occupy the same root sequence.

activation_trace.role: Withholding and contracted refusal supply the operative disposition carried by عَلَىٰ.
Narrowing something to a scant measure turns their supposed ability into scarcity production.
Effective capacity keeps the constrictive sense attached to an actual claim of agency.

changed_reading.before: They were capable of carrying out a plan.
changed_reading.after: They understand capability precisely as the power to withhold and compress someone else's portion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: حَرْدٍ admits anger as well as intent, and قَادِرِينَ admits deliberate arrangement.
baseline_models.mechanism: The departure can be affectively charged: irritation hardens into a plan, and planning gives anger a practical route into action.

activation_trace.role: Morning departure supplies the rapid conversion of disposition into movement.
Anger and irritated aggression supply the affective pressure behind the undertaking.
Arrangement by estimate and deliberation gives the anger an organized execution path.

changed_reading.after: Calculation and anger coexist: offended contraction is converted into an orderly morning operation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The contiguous حَرْدٍ قَادِرِينَ permits a bodily echo between constrained gait and fitted measure.
baseline_models.mechanism: The group can be heard as moving with an uneven or constrained gait while still placing itself in a measured, controlled formation. Apparent mastery therefore contains bodily strain from the start.

activation_trace.role: Setting out supplies actual locomotion for the gait image.
Defective or armor-constrained gait introduces strain and uneven movement.
Fitting proportion and measured foot placement supply compensating precision.

changed_reading.after: Their controlled advance may already be a strained, compensating gait whose precision masks instability.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier character type who withholds good becomes a concrete protocol: oath, harvest cut, refusal of exception, suppressed speech, and prevention of a poor person's entry. The focus phrase compresses that protocol into a posture in which withholding is treated as operational competence.

activation_trace.role: Contracted refusal supplies the focus verse's exclusionary footing.
Constriction to a scant measure supplies the intended result of their capacity.
Holding the hand back from giving supplies the broader social pattern enacted in the garden.
A binding oath supplies collective commitment to the operation.
The palm harvest supplies the material object they intend to seize and sever.
Exception as removal from a whole makes their refusal to except anything a closed plan.
Lowered secret speech supplies concealment as an enabling tactic.
Entry into an interior supplies the access point they intend to close.
The abasement of poverty identifies whose access their competence is designed to defeat.

structural_cues: 68:17-24 lays out oath, timing, movement, whisper, and an explicit no-entry rule before 68:25 states the operative posture.
68:22 repeats the focus departure root and pairs it with the cultivated field and cutting, making 68:25 an execution beat rather than a fresh scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withholding, oath, cutting, exception, secrecy, entry, and poverty; I infer a causal chain in which secrecy enables exclusion and exclusion is counted as ability. A live alternative is that secrecy marks only haste or embarrassment, while capability remains generic.

changed_reading.before: They depart with firm resolve and enough ability to harvest.
changed_reading.after: They depart under an exclusion protocol, treating the engineered denial of another's share as the very content of being capable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The restrictive force they intend to direct outward returns upon their own yield and perception. A surrounding visitation leaves a severed remnant; seeing produces not mastery but loss, and intended deprivation ends in their own deprivation.

activation_trace.role: Drying up of rain or yield supplies the state they unknowingly approach.
Constriction supplies a reversible operation that can narrow their own portion.
An encompassing circuit supplies the counter-agency surrounding the garden.
A piece already severed supplies the material result before their own cut can occur.
Visual and inward seeing supplies the moment their confident model meets the altered object.
Loss of the thing supplies their first diagnosis when possession no longer matches expectation.
Deprivation and missing the sought object complete the reversal onto the planners.

structural_cues: The acting subject shifts from the owners in 68:17-18 to a night visitation in 68:19, before the owners resume movement in 68:21-25.
Their certainty in 68:25 is immediately answered by visual disorientation and self-recognition in 68:26-27.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies encompassing motion, severance, seeing, loss, and deprivation; I infer that the intended arrow of constriction rebounds from the poor onto the planners. Alternatively, the event can be read as simple interruption rather than a formally mirrored operation.

changed_reading.before: قَادِرِينَ reports an ability they actually possess at departure.
changed_reading.after: قَادِرِينَ becomes locally sincere but globally ironic: the constrictive power they claim has already operated against them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The plural actors initially look like one capable body, but the aftermath differentiates a just middle voice, mutually facing parts, blame, admission of excess, and a wish for replacement. Their collective capacity is therefore a temporary coalition, not a uniform interior state.

activation_trace.role: Withdrawal apart and being alone supplies a latent fracture inside the collective posture.
Effective control supplies the shared capability the plural group projects.
The just or choice middle identifies a morally differentiated member within the group.
A group turning toward one another supplies the reorientation from common target to internal confrontation.
Partition into parts makes the formerly seamless plural analytically divisible.
Mutual reproach supplies the social force that exposes internal disagreement.
Crossing the limit supplies their retrospective diagnosis of the shared operation.
One thing standing in place of another supplies a newly imaginable future beyond the failed coalition's object.

structural_cues: The focus verse uses plural movement and plural capability without naming individual positions.
68:28-32 progressively differentiates speaker, parts, blame, confession, and redirected desire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a middle member, partition, confrontation, blame, excess, and replacement; I infer that the unified capability of 68:25 suppresses live internal difference. Alternatively, the differences may arise only after failure and need not have existed during departure.

changed_reading.before: A homogeneous group advances with one intent.
changed_reading.after: A coalition performs unanimity at departure, while the later fracture reveals unequal judgment and different capacities for correction within it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The owners' practical power shades into unauthorized jurisdiction. Later questions about judgment, binding inscription, oaths, and a guarantor expose the missing warrant behind their confidence: they act as if capacity itself grants the right to allocate access.

activation_trace.role: Settled aim supplies the practical decision they take as sufficient authorization.
Deliberate arrangement supplies their private allocation scheme.
Judgment between people supplies the juridical register against which their private decision is tested.
An inscription that establishes an obligation supplies the absent external warrant.
The oath branch supplies the imagined binding guarantee behind claimed entitlement.
Bearing a guarantee supplies the demanded accountable agent their plan lacks.

structural_cues: 68:36-41 repeatedly asks what authorizes the audience's preferred judgment: a book, binding oaths, a guarantor, or partners.
The branchless كَيْفَ at 68:36 functions only as a structural interrogation of method and is not assigned a branch citation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies judgment, binding writing, oath, and guarantee; I infer that the garden owners confuse effective capacity with legitimate jurisdiction. A live alternative is that the later legal interrogation addresses a broader audience and only analogically illuminates the garden scene.

changed_reading.before: They believe they can execute a private plan.
changed_reading.after: They behave as self-authorized allocators, mistaking the ability to enforce a distribution for the right to judge who receives it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The emphatic bodily competence of the morning group is reversed by a later scene of being summoned to lower the body while unable. Soundness had made response possible, but practiced capability for control has not become capacity for submission.

activation_trace.role: Effective bodily and practical capacity supplies the focus claim that is later negated.
Constrained gait supplies an embodied fault line already latent in their forward motion.
Ability and capacity supply the explicit later inability to perform the called action.
Lowering and submission supply the bodily direction their capacity cannot take.
Abasement supplies the involuntary posture replacing chosen forward control.
Brokenness under compulsion supplies the affective consequence of failed capacity.
Prior soundness supplies the lost opportunity in which responsive action had been possible.

structural_cues: 68:25 closes on a plural participle of capability; 68:42 closes its summons with an explicit plural inability.
The movement axis reverses from going out upon a posture to being unable to lower oneself when called.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies effective capacity, constrained gait, inability, lowering, abasement, and prior soundness; I infer a moral asymmetry between capacity for control and capacity for response. Alternatively, the later bodily scene may remain independent rather than intentionally echoing the garden walkers.

changed_reading.before: قَادِرِينَ is a neutral report of bodily and practical competence.
changed_reading.after: Their competence is directional and morally selective: they can advance to dominate, yet this does not train the body to answer a call to lower itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: The group's one-morning plan can be nested within a slower counter-plan. Their apparently unhindered advance becomes one degree in a process whose delay and firmness allow self-confidence to ripen into exposure.

activation_trace.role: The compressed early departure supplies the actors' short operational timescale.
Their estimated arrangement supplies the plan nested inside a larger process.
Taking by degrees supplies the slower enclosing process.
Granting respite and extending duration supplies the delay in which confidence continues.
Counter-strategy supplies the larger agency within which their own scheme operates.
Extended solidity supplies the durability of that counter-process.

structural_cues: 68:44-45 pairs unrecognized degree-by-degree movement with temporal extension and a firm counter-plan.
Within the garden episode, the decisive change has already occurred at night while the owners experience their morning movement as initiative.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies degrees, respite, counter-strategy, and solidity; I infer that the owners' confident departure is itself a stage of exposure rather than an interruption of the larger plan. Alternatively, 68:44-45 may state a general warning with no temporal modeling of 68:25.

changed_reading.before: The owners are the initiating planners in the scene.
changed_reading.after: Their initiative is nested agency: the confident morning step advances them inside a slower, firmer process they do not perceive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening images of a pared writing tool, ordered inscription, and measuring formation activate the planning branch of ق د ر. The owners move as if following a script they have cut, measured, and authorized for themselves, while their dismissal of another inscription as false stories exposes competing accounts of reality.

activation_trace.role: Aim and earnest resolve supply the line of action the group follows.
Arrangement by calculation supplies their self-authored practical script.
Paring a hard object into shape supplies the constructive cutting by which a plan becomes an instrument.
An ordered written line supplies the model of action proceeding along an authored sequence.
The false-story branch supplies a competing act of textual classification that protects the actors' preferred account.
Measuring and proportioning a thing supplies a distant but live bridge to calculated formation.

structural_cues: The surah opens with writing and what is written, then later embeds the garden action as a narrated test.
68:15 marks a conflict over which account counts as true inscription and which is dismissed as fabricated story.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shaping, inscription, false-story classification, and measured planning; I infer that the owners enact a rival practical script whose sequence feels authoritative to them. A live alternative is that the opening writing register belongs only to prophetic discourse and does not model the garden plan.

changed_reading.before: They carry out a plan formed within the garden episode.
changed_reading.after: They advance along a self-authored script, mistaking a measured sequence of actions for an authoritative account of what reality will permit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates meteorological branches under ordinary words for morning departure, lordship, and calling; it remains rooted in the focus triad of morning cloud, dried yield, and constricted measure and is sharpened by a garden altered overnight. Render it only as an ecological image-pattern, not as a replacement lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: غَدَوْا can echo a morning-forming cloud, while حَرْدٍ and قَادِرِينَ can align dried yield with constricted measure.

activation_trace.role: A cloud forming in the morning supplies the unexpected ecological vehicle.
Drying up of rain and milk supplies withheld fertility.
Narrowing to a scant measure supplies the ecological effect on yield.
The cloud branch supplies a context echo attached to the nocturnal counter-agent.
Moisture and rain supply the fertility that the focus's drought image reverses.

changed_reading.before: The morning setting is only a clock time for human action.
changed_reading.after: The actors become an inverted morning cloud: instead of bearing moisture, their movement images the deliberate contraction of fertility and yield.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain bodily reading rather than the likely primary syntax; it remains anchored in the explicit focus branches for gait and fitted proportion, with a later branch-backed image of footing that cannot hold. Downstream prose should present it as a physicalized irony of control, not claim that حَرْدٍ simply means slipping.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: حَرْدٍ قَادِرِينَ can pair constrained movement with measured placement, making bodily control a live secondary register.

activation_trace.role: A defective or constrained gait supplies effortful locomotion.
Fitted proportion and measured footfall supply apparent control over that gait.
A smooth place on which the foot cannot remain supplies the later destabilizing surface.

changed_reading.before: Their advance is stable because every movement is under control.
changed_reading.after: Their measured gait performs mastery on unstable footing; control is compensatory and can lose purchase.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading activates distant food branches of the two focus roots, so it should not be lexicalized as breakfast or cooking in translation. It remains worth carrying because harvest, cutting, denied entry, and poverty make the conversion of shared yield into privately controlled food a coherent material mechanism.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The early-meal branch of غ د و and cooking-pot branch of ق د ر can materialize the exclusionary force of حَرْدٍ.

activation_trace.role: The early-day meal supplies the consumption endpoint hidden inside morning movement.
Withholding supplies the privatizing rule governing that food.
The cooking pot and its associated processing supply conversion of cut yield into controlled consumption.
Harvesting the palms supplies the raw-food acquisition stage.
Entry supplies the threshold at which access to the food chain is denied.
Poverty supplies the excluded consumer whose absence makes the meal private.

changed_reading.before: The plan concerns ownership of an agricultural yield.
changed_reading.after: At the material edge of the root field, the plan privatizes an entire food path from morning harvest through processing to consumption.

strongest_changes: حَرْدٍ and قَادِرِينَ converge on a model in which the production of scarcity is mistaken for effective capacity.
The deprivation intended for the poor rebounds onto the planners, making their capability sincere at the local moment but ironic in the completed sequence.
Later inability to lower the body distinguishes capacity for domination from capacity for responsive submission.
The plural group fractures after failure, revealing that its performed unanimity concealed unequal judgment and corrigibility.
summary.what_was_special: The focus verse behaves like a compressed hinge: aim, withholding, anger, gait, measure, power, and planning coexist in three roots, while the surrounding sequence sends each mechanism in more than one direction. The odd food, weather, and footing branches remain productive when contained as image-patterns rather than forced translations.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether حَرْدٍ primarily coordinates intent, withholding, anger, or a deliberate polysemy cannot be settled by the packet alone.
The legal-warrant and inscription models may be whole-surah analogies rather than direct mechanisms internal to the garden episode.
The gait, cloud, and meal readings are branch-backed but form-distant and should remain exploratory.
Later group differentiation does not prove that disagreement was already conscious at the moment of departure.
